text:
Devon: picking up latewatch, transferring primary to Ana now — leaving quick checklist below
Ana: ack, grabbing it. main symptom?
Devon: p99 spike on inference-api across region-us-east-1, started ~10m ago. errors are low, but tail latency up ~3x. Looks like a KV cold/warm imbalance after the config flip last night.
Marcus: incident-bot said: Pager alert: inference-api p99 > 1200ms (threshold 800ms) — https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260315-42 :eyes:
oncall-bot: Pager triggered by metric alert: inference-api.p99 (us-east-1) — severity: high.
Ana: thanks. immediate next steps from Devon's handover: 1) check `kv-cache` eviction rate 2) confirm autoscaler didn't downscale 3) check recent deploys to inference-config
Sam: logs show lots of MV eviction churn: `kv_evictions_per_min: 480` and `cache_fill_rate` dropped. Dump here: ```
[INF] 03-15 21:34:12 eviction key=/model-7/seq-...
[INF] 03-15 21:34:13 eviction key=/model-7/seq-...
```
Elaine: good catch. possible causes: batch_size bump, kernel change, or worker restart. Any recent deploy? Marcus, you did the midnight canary?
Marcus: I rolled a config PR last night to increase `max_batch_tokens` from 2048->4096 for cost reasons. Canary looked fine under synthetic load but maybe it changed cache residency. Rolling back is an option but we can try faster mitigations first.
Ana: OK fast runway plan: 1) pin primary to older config (canary rollback) if quick 2) temporarily increase pool size (scale up warm nodes) 3) lower `max_batch_tokens` to previous value via runtime override 4) if still bad, restart a subset of workers to rebuild warm caches.
Devon: I'll run the scaler change and an override. Which autoscaler group? `rnw-infer-pool-us-east-1-production`
Sam: command to add 2 nodes (g4x2 equivalent): `infractl scale pool rnw-infer-pool-us-east-1-production --add 2`
Ana: while you scale, Marcus please prepare a quick rollback PR (no need for full review) and post the link. If rollout is <5m we can revert quickly.
Marcus: PR https://git.redwood/repo/inference-config/pulls/781 — rollback to batch_tokens=2048. WIP, can merge on :thumbsup:.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: Canary run started for PR 781 in us-east-1 — https://deploys.redwood/deploy/7823
Sam: I'm seeing CPU on warm nodes at ~70% and GPU memory more stable after adding nodes, p99 dropped from 1200ms -> 900ms in the last 3 mins. Good sign.
Elaine: Runbook pointers (quick): 
- KV eviction triage: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-checks 
- Scale pool/playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/scale-inference-pool 
- Quick rollback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-fast-path 
(These are the short checks — please open runbook and follow the step-by-step if escalates)
Ana: checklist I'm running through now: 
- [x] confirm alert owners and customer impact (no elevated error rate, but response-time degradation)
- [x] notify CS (low-level): "Investigating latency; degraded tail, not errors. ETA ~20m"
- [x] increase pool via infractl — done by Sam
- [ ] merge rollback PR if p99 not below 800ms in 10m
- [ ] consider rolling restarts of hot workers (staggered)
Devon: FYI to oncall rotation: I'm primary until 22:00 UTC then Ana takes over. Marcus is secondary. Leave notes in the handover thread when you swap.
Sam: p99 now at ~760ms. Looks like scale helped. I'll keep monitoring for 15m.
Ana: if p99 reverts, plan B is to merge PR and trigger canary rollback, then monitor. Also prepare `tcpdump` snippet for any weird cross-host bandwidth issues: `sudo tcpdump -i any port 12345 -c 200 -w /tmp/pkts.pcap`
Marcus: I'll keep PR ready and watch canary. If rollback goes green on canary, we'll promote.
Elaine: customer impact note: flagged a few high-value customers seeing slow responses in support queue. CS updated with: "Degraded latency for inference in US-East; engineers are actively rolling mitigations. No data loss expected."
Ana: final quick commands saved here for whoever takes over: 
```
# check eviction rates
kubectl -n inference exec -it deploy/kv-metrics -- curl localhost:8000/metrics | grep kv_evictions
# scale pool
infractl scale pool rnw-infer-pool-us-east-1-production --add 2
# rollback config (if approved)
git checkout refs/pull/781 && infractl apply -f inference-config.yaml --region us-east-1
```
Devon: leaving this open for handover notes. Ana you are primary now — tag me if you need me to escalate to infra.
Ana: thanks — taking over. I'll post a short handover when I swap out at 22:00 UTC with final state and links to any open changes. :white_check_mark:
Sam: monitoring, will ping if anything spikes.
Marcus: standing by to merge PR if needed.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Primary rotation scheduled for 22:00 UTC — please update oncall roster.
Ana: noted. end of thread for now, moving to live watch.
